adoption.rationale: The pinned docs describe exact-SHA invalidation, and the server emits a head SHA only after validating the webhook request. The receiver checks the exact 40-hex token before calling the cache invalidator; adoption is limited to that downstream argument invariant.

declared_domain: Exact Aidevops pin 8666b6c6c52472b5535aa295f2df593918152cb1; ASCII strings in the authenticated local action protocol, with the intended SHA domain exactly 40 characters from 0-9, A-F, or a-f.
guarantee: The receiver calls gh_pr_check_status_cache_invalidate only when the webhook-derived SHA token is exactly 40 ASCII hexadecimal characters and the repository slug also passes _webhook_valid_slug.
input_source: The head SHA associated with a check, status, or workflow event in a GitHub webhook payload. The pinned Python server verifies the request signature and emits the validated value in the local action protocol; the shell helper validates it again before cache invalidation.
